label: NAR, from the root's withholding of each grounded being, bridge (b2) and the common root
meaning: Let x be a NECESSARY_2 actual concretum and suppose it has an actual concrete G-ground. The common root n of 0c27f65a (only its root and reach clauses are used) is x (impossible: a root has no ground) or grounds x. By (a), n exists at some accessible world v and does not give x being there. x is necessary, so by (b2) n gives x being at v: contradiction. So x is an actual root. Constructive.
